mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (user_id, content_type, content_id, content, is_violation, matched_words, categories, audit_result, auditor_id, audit_remark, create_time, audit_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{content}, #{isViolation}, #{matchedWords}, #{categories}, #{auditResult}, #{auditorId}, #{auditRemark}, #{createTime}, #{auditTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM audit_log WHERE audit_result = #{auditResult}
mapper.update: UPDATE audit_log SET audit_result = #{auditResult}, auditor_id = #{auditorId}, audit_remark = #{remark}, audit_time = NOW() WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
